title: Reset a forgotten password
keywords: password forgot reset expired locked login sign in
steps: Verify the user's identity using the standard verification questions.
Reset the password in Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID and set 'change at next sign-in'.
Confirm the user can sign in, then close the ticket.

title: Unlock a locked-out account
keywords: account locked out lockout too many attempts disabled
steps: Check the lockout source in Active Directory (Event ID 4740).
Unlock the account and ask the user to update saved passwords on phones and mapped drives.
Monitor for repeat lockouts over the next hour.

title: MFA prompt not received or new phone
keywords: mfa authenticator two factor 2fa code new phone verification text
steps: Confirm the user's identity.
Require re-registration of MFA methods in Microsoft Entra ID.
Walk the user through setting up Microsoft Authenticator on the new device.

title: Request access to a shared folder or application
keywords: access permission denied shared folder drive request permissions role
steps: Get manager approval for the requested access.
Add the user to the correct security group (never assign permissions to individuals).
Ask the user to sign out and back in, then confirm access.

title: No internet or network connection
keywords: internet network wifi wi-fi offline disconnected no connection ethernet slow
steps: Check if the issue affects one user or many (possible outage).
Run ipconfig /all, confirm a valid IP address, then ipconfig /release and /renew.
Test DNS with nslookup; flush with ipconfig /flushdns if needed.
Escalate to the network team if multiple users are affected.

title: VPN will not connect
keywords: vpn remote connect tunnel home working from home
steps: Confirm the user's home internet works.
Check the VPN client version and the user's VPN group membership.
Reinstall the VPN client if the error persists.

title: Printer not printing or jobs stuck in queue
keywords: printer print printing queue stuck paper jam toner offline scan scanner
steps: Check the printer is online and has paper and toner.
Clear the print queue and restart the Print Spooler service.
Remove and re-add the printer if it still shows offline.

title: Computer, monitor, or peripheral not working
keywords: monitor screen keyboard mouse laptop computer pc dock headset hardware broken wont turn on battery
steps: Check cables, power, and the docking station.
Try the device on another port or computer to isolate the fault.
Book a hardware swap if the device is faulty.

title: Application crashing, freezing, or showing an error
keywords: error crash crashing freeze frozen not responding application app software bug emr
steps: Record the exact error message and steps to reproduce.
Clear the app cache, update to the latest version, and restart.
Check application logs; escalate to the vendor or engineering with the details if unresolved.

title: Install or update software
keywords: install installation update upgrade software license new program
steps: Confirm the software is approved and a license is available.
Deploy through the standard software deployment tool.
Verify the install and confirm with the user.

title: Outlook or email not syncing
keywords: email outlook mail inbox sync sending receiving calendar teams mailbox
steps: Check Microsoft 365 service health for outages.
Restart Outlook in safe mode and repair the profile if needed.
Check mailbox size limits.

title: Suspected phishing email or security incident
keywords: phishing suspicious email link clicked virus malware scam hacked security breach
steps: Tell the user not to click any more links or attachments.
If credentials were entered, reset the password and revoke sessions immediately.
Report the email to the security team and isolate the device if malware is suspected.
